description: Step 2: pay the quote and have the relayer create the manager. Costs the quoted USDC (usually $0.10, never above what quote_create_manager said without asking again). Without payment the result is an error whose structuredContent is the x402 PaymentRequired: an x402 MCP client retries with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]; any other client POSTs to `payUrl` and pays its HTTP 402 with an x402 wallet. If gas rose since the quote a new PaymentRequired comes back and nothing is charged. One quote creates one manager; calling again returns the operation. Returns the operation: status (sent/done/failed), the manager address (from the factory's EnvelopV2Deployment event) once mined, the transaction.
name: create_manager
title: Create a manager (paid, x402)
